# Hardware Replacement & Warranty Lifecycle SOP

- **Doc ID:** `KB-HW-303`
- **Canonical URL:** `https://kb.enterprise.internal/hardware/lifecycle-and-swaps`
- **Classification:** Tier-1 Operations Standard

## 1. Laptop Display & Battery Swaps
1. Employees experiencing screen flickering, dead pixel clusters exceeding 3 pixels, or battery cycle counts > 1,000 qualify for immediate hardware swap.
2. Visit the Building C IT Kiosk between 09:00 - 17:00 with your employee badge.
3. Loaner laptops with standard developer images are deployed within 30 minutes.

## 2. Peripherals & Accessories
Monitors, docking stations, USB-C chargers, and mechanical keyboards can be ordered via the Enterprise IT Equipment Portal with direct manager signoff.
